requirements.text: Students should be able to color-code their modules, hide canceled classes, add personal study blocks, and sync their personalized timetables with external calendar applications.
Students must be able to choose their preferred channel for receiving notifications about grades and deadlines (email, SMS, or in-app) and customize the frequency of these notifications.
The module feedback system should allow students to assess content quality, course delivery, and resources through a structured survey while ensuring anonymity.
Feedback collected should only be accessible to module coordinators after the grading submission deadline to maintain academic integrity.

All enhancements must integrate with the existing authentication system, avoid modifications to the current database schema, maintain portal performance, and comply with GDPR and data retention policies.
